description: Short self-report survey (30 items, about 5 minutes) that measures eight learner characteristics known to change how someone should be taught. Items are our own teen-friendly wording, modelled on the published scales listed under each category. They are not the validated originals, so scores are for building a learning profile, never for diagnosis.

scoring.method: Reverse items marked reverse (6 - answer). Average the answered items of a category. Normalise the mean to 0-100 with (mean - 1) / 4 * 100. A category with no answers is reported as unknown.
scoring.direction: Higher scores always mean the student finds this easier. The low band is where the student needs the most support.

categories.name: Prior knowledge
categories.title: What you already know
categories.hint: About the topic you told us about. Answer for this topic only.
categories.measures: How much the student already knows about the topic they are learning now.
categories.why_it_matters: The strongest known moderator of instruction (expertise reversal effect): guidance that helps beginners slows down students who already know the material.

items.text: I already know quite a lot about the topic I'm learning.
items.text_de: Ich weiß schon ziemlich viel über das Thema, das ich gerade lerne.

items.text: I could explain the basics of this topic to a friend.
items.text_de: Ich könnte jemandem die Grundlagen dieses Themas erklären.

items.text: Most of this topic is completely new to me.
items.text_de: Das meiste an diesem Thema ist völlig neu für mich.

low.student_text: This topic is mostly new to you.
low.student_text_de: Das Thema ist für dich größtenteils neu.
low.student_reason: So we explain the essentials first and show examples before you start on your own.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb erklären wir dir erst das Wichtigste und zeigen Beispiele, bevor du selbst loslegst.
ai_instructions: Treat the student as a beginner in this topic.
Start with a short overview of how the topic fits together.
Teach with worked examples before asking them to solve anything alone.
Define every technical term the first time it appears.

medium.student_text: You know some of this already, so we build on it.
medium.student_text_de: Du kennst schon einiges, darauf bauen wir auf.
ai_instructions: Briefly check what they know, then skip what they have.
Mix worked examples with practice and reduce the guidance as they succeed.

high.student_text_de: Du kennst dich mit dem Thema gut aus.
high.student_reason: So we skip the basics and start right away with exercises.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb überspringen wir die Grundlagen und fangen gleich mit Aufgaben an.
ai_instructions: Skip introductions to basics and avoid repeating what they know.
Lead with problems and challenges; give step-by-step guidance only when asked.
Focus on gaps, edge cases, and applying the knowledge.

categories.hint_de: Zu dem Thema, das du angegeben hast. Antworte nur für dieses Thema.

categories.name: Working memory
categories.title: Keeping things in mind
categories.hint: How much you can hold in your head while you work.
categories.measures: How many pieces of information the student can hold and use at the same time.
categories.why_it_matters: Decides how much should be on screen at once and how big each step can be (cognitive load theory).

based_on.name: ADEXI working memory subscale (Holst & Thorell, 2018) and CHEXI (Thorell & Nyberg, 2008)

items.text: When I get instructions with several steps, I forget some of them.
items.text_de: Wenn ich Anweisungen mit mehreren Schritten bekomme, vergesse ich einige davon.

items.text: If someone interrupts me, I lose track of what I was doing.
items.text_de: Wenn mich jemand unterbricht, weiß ich nicht mehr, was ich gerade gemacht habe.

items.text: I can keep several pieces of information in my head while I work something out.
items.text_de: Ich kann mehrere Informationen im Kopf behalten, während ich etwas ausarbeite.

items.text: In a long explanation, I've forgotten the start by the time it ends.
items.text_de: Bei einer langen Erklärung habe ich den Anfang vergessen, wenn sie zu Ende ist.

low.student_text: You learn best with one thing on the screen at a time.
low.student_text_de: Du lernst am besten, wenn immer nur eine Sache auf dem Bildschirm ist.
low.student_reason: So we show one idea per screen and recap briefly.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb zeigen wir dir eine Idee pro Bildschirm und fassen kurz zusammen.
ai_instructions: Show one idea per screen, in chunks of at most three short sentences.
Never require the student to remember something from an earlier screen; repeat it where it is needed.
Give instructions as a numbered list they can see while working.
Add a one-line recap after every chunk.
Place labels and explanations directly next to the picture or example they belong to.

medium.student_text: You handle a fair amount at once, with a recap now and then.
medium.student_text_de: Du kommst mit einer Menge auf einmal klar, mit einer kurzen Zusammenfassung zwischendurch.
ai_instructions: Use moderate chunks of one short paragraph.
Recap at the end of each section and keep multi-step instructions visible.

high.student_text: You can juggle several ideas at once.
high.student_text_de: Du kannst mehrere Ideen gleichzeitig jonglieren.
high.student_reason: So explanations can be longer and show several ideas together.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb dürfen Erklärungen länger sein und mehrere Ideen zusammen zeigen.
ai_instructions: Longer explanations and several connected ideas per screen are fine.
Keep recaps brief; don't over-split the material.

categories.hint_de: Wie viel du dir merken kannst, während du arbeitest.

categories.name: Attention
categories.title: Staying focused
categories.hint: How it goes when you try to concentrate.
categories.measures: How steadily the student keeps attention on a task and how easily it drifts or gets pulled away.
categories.why_it_matters: Sets session length, how often the tool checks in, and how much is shown at once.

based_on.name: Spontaneous Mind Wandering scale (Carriere, Seli & Smilek, 2013)

items.text: My thoughts drift off without me noticing, even when I want to concentrate.
items.text_de: Meine Gedanken schweifen ab, ohne dass ich es merke, selbst wenn ich mich konzentrieren will.

items.text: I can stay focused for a long time, even when a task isn't exciting.
items.text_de: Ich kann mich lange konzentrieren, auch wenn eine Aufgabe nicht spannend ist.

items.text: My phone, noises, or other things easily pull me away from what I'm doing.
items.text_de: Mein Handy, Geräusche oder andere Dinge lenken mich leicht ab.

items.text: I reach the end of a page and realise I have no idea what it said.
items.text_de: Ich komme am Ende einer Seite an und merke, dass ich keine Ahnung habe, was dort stand.

low.student_text: Your focus comes in short bursts.
low.student_text_de: Dein Fokus kommt in kurzen Schüben.
low.student_reason: So we keep sessions short, with small tasks in between.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb machen wir kurze Einheiten mit kleinen Aufgaben zwischendurch.
ai_instructions: Keep sessions to 5-10 minutes with a clear end point.
Ask for a small interaction (a tap, a quick question) every 2-3 minutes so drifting is noticed early.
Offer a focus mode that shows only the current sentence or block and dims everything else.
Show visible progress after every step.
Avoid long passive content such as long videos or long pages of text.

medium.student_text: You can focus for a while, with a check-in now and then.
medium.student_text_de: Du kannst eine Weile konzentriert bleiben, mit einer kurzen Rückfrage zwischendurch.
ai_instructions: Use sessions of about 15-20 minutes.
Check understanding at the end of each section.

high.student_text: You can stay focused for long stretches.
high.student_reason: So sessions can be longer, and we rarely interrupt you.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb dürfen die Einheiten länger sein, und wir unterbrechen dich selten.
ai_instructions: Longer sessions and longer content are fine.
Keep interruptions and check-ins to a minimum.

categories.hint_de: Wie es läuft, wenn du dich konzentrieren willst.

categories.name: Reading and language
categories.title: Reading
categories.hint: How reading goes for you, in the language your material is in.
categories.measures: Whether reading itself, or the language of the material, is a barrier.
categories.why_it_matters: Decides whether text should be read aloud, simplified, or replaced by audio and visuals. Text-to-speech has a measurable benefit for students with reading difficulties.

based_on.name: Adult Reading History Questionnaire, short form (Khanolainen et al., 2024)

items.text: Reading takes me longer than most people my age.
items.text_de: Ich brauche zum Lesen länger als die meisten in meinem Alter.

items.text: When I read, letters or words seem to jump, blur, or swap places.
items.text_de: Beim Lesen scheinen Buchstaben oder Wörter zu springen, zu verschwimmen oder die Plätze zu tauschen.

items.text: I often have to read a sentence twice to understand it.
items.text_de: Ich muss einen Satz oft zweimal lesen, um ihn zu verstehen.

items.text: The language my material is in is not my strongest language.
items.text_de: Die Sprache, in der mein Material ist, ist nicht meine stärkste Sprache.

low.student_reason: So we read texts out to you and keep them short and simple.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb lesen wir dir Texte vor und halten sie kurz und einfach.
ai_instructions: Offer read-aloud for all text and turn it on by default.
Use plain language, short sentences, and short paragraphs.
Use a large, clear font with extra line and letter spacing; never justify text.
Explain key words in a small glossary and show them visually where possible.
Prefer audio, diagrams, and examples over long text.

medium.student_text: Reading works, and we'll offer read-aloud when texts get long.
medium.student_text_de: Lesen klappt, und bei langen Texten bieten wir dir Vorlesen an.
ai_instructions: Offer an optional read-aloud button.
Keep paragraphs short and explain difficult words.

high.student_reason: So texts can stay as they are, without extra help.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb dürfen Texte ganz normal bleiben, ohne extra Hilfen.
ai_instructions: Text is a good format for this student; no special reading support is needed.

categories.hint_de: Wie Lesen für dich läuft, in der Sprache deines Materials.

categories.name: Self-regulation
categories.title: Getting started and keeping on track
categories.hint: How you plan, start, and finish things.
categories.measures: How well the student starts tasks, plans, and keeps going without outside structure.
categories.why_it_matters: Decides how much outside structure the tool provides: a ready plan, reminders, and tiny first steps, or freedom to self-direct.

based_on.name: Self-regulated learning research, short self-regulation questionnaires

items.text: I put off starting tasks, even when I know I should begin.
items.text_de: Ich schiebe Aufgaben auf, obwohl ich weiß, dass ich anfangen sollte.

items.text: When I have a big task, I break it into smaller steps on my own.
items.text_de: Wenn ich eine große Aufgabe habe, teile ich sie selbst in kleinere Schritte auf.

items.text: I usually finish what I planned to do.
items.text_de: Ich schaffe meistens, was ich mir vorgenommen habe.

items.text: I lose track of time, and deadlines take me by surprise.
items.text_de: Ich verliere das Zeitgefühl, und Abgabetermine überraschen mich.

low.student_reason: So you get a ready-made plan and a tiny first step.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb bekommst du einen fertigen Plan und einen winzigen ersten Schritt.
ai_instructions: Give a ready-made plan instead of asking the student to plan.
Begin every session with one tiny first step that takes under two minutes.
Show one task at a time with a clear start button.
Make time visible: how long a step takes and how much is left.
Acknowledge every finished step right away.

medium.student_text: You can keep yourself going, and a plan helps.
medium.student_text_de: Du schaffst es, dich selbst anzutreiben, und ein Plan hilft dir dabei.
ai_instructions: Suggest a plan the student can adjust.
Use light reminders and show progress over the week.

high.student_text: You plan and start well on your own.
high.student_text_de: Du planst und fängst von allein gut an.
high.student_reason: So you make the plan yourself and choose the order.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb planst du selbst und wählst die Reihenfolge.
ai_instructions: Let the student plan and choose the order.
Offer tools such as checklists or timers as options, not rules.

categories.hint_de: Wie du planst, anfängst und Dinge zu Ende bringst.

categories.name: Appetite for thinking
categories.title: How you like to think
categories.hint: Whether you enjoy tricky problems or prefer things clear and simple.
categories.measures: How much the student enjoys effortful thinking and open problems.
categories.why_it_matters: Decides depth and openness: open questions and challenges, or concrete, guided tasks.

based_on.name: Need for Cognition, NCS-6 (Lins de Holanda Coelho, Hanel & Wolf, 2020)

items.text: I like problems that make me think hard.
items.text_de: Ich mag Aufgaben, bei denen ich richtig nachdenken muss.

items.text: I'd rather be told the answer than figure it out myself.
items.text_de: Ich bekomme lieber die Antwort gesagt, als sie selbst herauszufinden.

items.text: I enjoy finding a new way to solve something.
items.text_de: Es macht mir Spaß, einen neuen Weg zu finden, um etwas zu lösen.

items.text: Thinking about the same thing for a long time gets boring fast.
items.text_de: Lange über dieselbe Sache nachzudenken, wird mir schnell langweilig.

low.student_text: You like things clear and practical.
low.student_text_de: Du magst es klar und praktisch.
low.student_reason: So we stick to clear, practical tasks with one answer.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb bleiben wir bei klaren, praktischen Aufgaben mit einer Antwort.
ai_instructions: Keep content concrete and practical, and explain why it is useful.
Use short, guided tasks with one clear answer.
Avoid open-ended puzzles until the student is confident.

medium.student_text: You like a mix of clear steps and a good challenge.
medium.student_text_de: Du magst eine Mischung aus klaren Schritten und einer guten Herausforderung.
ai_instructions: Mix guided tasks with an occasional open question or challenge.

high.student_reason: So there are open questions and puzzles to dig deeper.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb gibt es offene Fragen und Knobelaufgaben zum Vertiefen.
ai_instructions: Add open questions, 'why' prompts, and challenge problems.
Offer optional deep dives and let the student explore different solutions.

categories.hint_de: Ob du knifflige Aufgaben magst oder es lieber klar und einfach hast.

categories.name: Self-belief
categories.title: Trusting yourself
categories.hint: How sure you feel about handling learning.
categories.measures: How confident the student is in their own ability to learn and solve tasks (self-efficacy).
categories.why_it_matters: Decides how fast difficulty rises and how much early success and encouragement the student needs.

based_on.name: ASKU short general self-efficacy scale (Beierlein et al., 2013), translated

items.text: If I put in the effort, I can understand even hard topics.
items.text_de: Wenn ich mich anstrenge, kann ich auch schwierige Themen verstehen.

items.text: When something is new to me, I trust myself to figure it out.
items.text_de: Wenn etwas neu für mich ist, traue ich mir zu, es herauszufinden.

items.text: I can handle most learning tasks I'm given.
items.text_de: Die meisten Lernaufgaben, die ich bekomme, kann ich bewältigen.

low.student_text: You quickly doubt whether you can do it.
low.student_text_de: Du zweifelst schnell, ob du das schaffst.
low.student_reason: So we start with tasks you will manage and build up slowly.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb starten wir mit Aufgaben, die du sicher schaffst, und steigern langsam.
ai_instructions: Start below the student's level so the first tasks are clear wins.
Raise difficulty slowly and only after success.
Point out concrete progress often ('You can now do X, which you couldn't yesterday').
Give specific, encouraging feedback; never compare with others.

medium.student_text: You trust yourself with most things, and we'll keep it that way.
medium.student_text_de: Du traust dir das Meiste zu, und das soll so bleiben.
ai_instructions: Start at the student's level and point out progress at the end of each session.

high.student_reason: So we start at your level or a little above.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb starten wir auf deinem Niveau oder etwas darüber.
ai_instructions: Start at or slightly above the student's level and keep the challenge up.

categories.hint_de: Wie sicher du dich beim Lernen fühlst.

categories.name: Bouncing back
categories.title: When things go wrong
categories.hint: How you deal with mistakes and frustrating moments.
categories.measures: How well the student copes with everyday setbacks such as mistakes, frustration, and pressure (academic buoyancy).
categories.why_it_matters: Decides feedback tone, how mistakes are shown, and when to suggest a break.

items.text: When I get something wrong, I can shake it off and keep going.
items.text_de: Wenn ich etwas falsch mache, kann ich es abhaken und weitermachen.

items.text: One mistake or bad mark can ruin my whole day.
items.text_de: Ein Fehler oder eine schlechte Note kann mir den ganzen Tag verderben.

items.text: When learning gets frustrating, I give up quickly.
items.text_de: Wenn Lernen frustrierend wird, gebe ich schnell auf.

items.text: I can handle a lot of pressure from school or studying.
items.text_de: Ich komme mit viel Druck von Schule oder Studium gut klar.

low.student_reason: So there are no points, no red marks, and a calm, warm tone.
low.student_reason_de: Deshalb gibt es keine Punkte, keine roten Striche und einen ruhigen, warmen Ton.
ai_instructions: Frame mistakes as 'not yet' and show the fix right away.
Avoid scores, red marks, streak losses, and visible timers.
After two mistakes in a row, make the next task easier or suggest a short break.
Keep the tone calm and warm.

medium.student_text: You usually bounce back, and we'll keep feedback clear and kind.
medium.student_text_de: Du fängst dich meistens wieder, und wir halten das Feedback klar und freundlich.
ai_instructions: Give clear, kind feedback with the correct answer and a short explanation.

high.student_reason: So we can be direct, and points or timed tasks are possible.
high.student_reason_de: Deshalb dürfen wir direkt sein, und Punkte oder Zeitaufgaben sind möglich.
ai_instructions: Direct feedback is fine.
Scores, streaks, and timed challenges can be used if the student enjoys them.

categories.hint_de: Wie du mit Fehlern und frustrierenden Momenten umgehst.

priority: Each item is high or low priority: 20 high, 10 low. Scoring uses every answered item regardless of priority.
